events.title: Dried Flower Resin Ornament Making Workshop Hosted by little bloomtale × KAJIHA
events.description:
Join us for a fun and creative Dried Flower Resin Craft Workshop at Makers Guild, Industry City!
Discover the art of preserving beautiful dried flowers in resin and create your own unique keepsake this holiday season. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing creative activity, a fun weekend experience, or a special handmade gift, this workshop is the perfect opportunity to try something new.
Guided by the talented KAJIHA florist and creative team, you’ll learn how to select and arrange dried flowers, pour resin, and design your very own beautiful ornament in a welcoming and friendly environment.
No prior experience is necessary! Just bring your creativity and enjoy the process.
*What You’ll Create
• One custom-designed dried flower resin piece of your choice: an ornament, necklace, bracelet, or keychain.
*What’s Included
• Dried flower materials
• Decorative ribbon
• Hanging string
• Materials and supplies for one resin ornament or jewelry
Celebrate the holiday season with flowers, creativity, and a little hands-on fun. Create a beautiful handmade keepsake to cherish or gift to someone special!
*By Appointment Only
Please register in advance on the KAJIHA website before visiting.
Spaces are limited. Sign up now and join us for a creative holiday experience!

events.description:
Elevate Your Senses, Immerse in Art and Embrace the Extraordinary.
Escape the hustle and bustle of the city and step into the warm, inviting atmosphere of our cozy studio for a one-of-a-kind Textured Paint and Sip experience. We combine the joy of creativity with the comfort of an intimate setting. Unleash your artistic side as you sip on curated beverages and enjoy delicious treats, all while guided by our talented instructors. Whether you’re an art lover or simply looking for a relaxing evening, our Textured Paint and Sip sessions offer the perfect blend of creativity, comfort, and inspiration.
Here are the details:
• 2 hours
• all materials
• aesthetic set up
• charcuterie boards with wine (we provide 1-2 glasses of wine per guest during our classes) or non-alcholic beverages
• networking
Where: our Brooklyn Living Room studio in Industry city Brooklyn
We secure a spot only after payment. Please note that the number of spots is limited.
Join us for a memorable journey that will leave you with beautiful art and cherished memories.
IMPORTANT:
– Tickets to our events are non-refundable and non-transferable between dates. All sales are final. If you can’t attend, please consider transferring your ticket to another guest. Contact us to let us know.
– Complimentary wine is offered to guests 21+. Valid government-issued ID may be requested
– We may take photos and videos during the event for promotional and social media purposes. If you prefer not to be photographed or filmed, please let us know in advance.
By purchasing a ticket, you acknowledge and agree to our event policies – designed to make your experience as mindful and inspiring as possible
Please make sure to enter the names of all guests when purchasing multiple tickets, as we prepare personalized name cards for each attendee. If all tickets are purchased under a single name, all name cards will be printed with that same name.

events.title: Portraits in Color: Exploring Light & Tone in Oils
events.description:
Discover how color can transform a portrait.
In this three-hour workshop, we’ll paint the head and shoulders, exploring how light, shadow, and shifts between warm and cool colors create depth and mood.
Choose from the provided portrait references and practice mixing colors, blending soft transitions, and building form with oil paint. I’ll guide you step by step, with time to experiment and make the portrait your own.
Beginners are welcome. All materials and reference images are included.
